marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind south 20 knots backing to east 15 early this evening then
to north 15 Wednesday morning. Wind increasing to northwest 25 Wednesday
afternoon. Scattered flurries changing to snow Wednesday morning then
to scattered flurries Wednesday afternoon. Visibility 1 mile or less in
snow. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text: Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less.<br/>
